title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC Sep minutes: most officials see year-end hike — 10yr yield hit 5.365% (24yr high), settled ~5.27%
BTC -3.3% → ~$83,285 | ETH -4.33% → ~$2,571; $500M+ longs liquidated
Gold fell below $4,100 after hawkish Fed minutes signal
Oct 28 FOMC hike odds ~22%, down from 51% a week ago
